en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large, ornate late‑19th‑century corner apartment or hotel building labeled as Haus "Columbus" on Parkstrasse. The multi‑story structure has many windows, decorative facades, and a mansard roof. In the foreground are leafless trees, a small fenced garden or pavilion, and people walking along intersecting streets. Printed captions appear below the image and along the left edge.
